title: Slovakia – Construction work – Stavebné práce na pozemných stavbách a pochôdznych terasách
description: Predmetom verejného obstarávania je vytvorenie dynamického nákupného systému (ďalej len "DNS") s názvom "Stavebné práce na pozemných stavbách a pochôdznych terasách", ktorý bude slúžiť na zadávanie zákaziek na uskutočnenie bežne dostupných stavebných prác na území hlavného mesta SR Bratislavy a s nimi súvisiacich služieb (ako napr. likvidácia spotrebného materiálu, odpadu a nebezpečného odpadu v súlade so zákonom č. 79/2015 Z. z. o odpadoch v platnom znení) a tovarov (ako napr. materiál potrebný na realizáciu prác). Predmetné DNS je v súlade s § 58 ods. 2 zákona č. 343/2015 Z. z. o verejnom obstarávaní a o zmene a doplnení niektorých zákonov (ďalej len "ZVO"), rozdelené do dvoch (2) kategórií: Kategória 1: Práce na pozemných stavbách Kategória 2: Práce na pochôdznych terasách Konkrétny rozsah predmetu zákazky, podrobná špecifikácia, konkrétne miesta uskutočnenia predmetu zákazky, ako aj ostatné doplňujúce informácie, budú súčasťou jednotlivých výziev v rámci zriadeného DNS, pričom výzvy v kategórii 1 a/alebo kategórii 2 DNS, budú zaslané iba kvalifikovaným (zaradeným) záujemcom do príslušnej kategórie 1 a/alebo kategórie 2 DNS, a to prostredníctvom systému JOSEPHINE. Pri obidvoch kategóriách predmetného DNS pôjde o stavebné práce na zabezpečenie opráv, údržbu poškodených častí, rekonštrukciu a sanáciu havarijného stavu, a v rámci rekonštrukčných prác na pozemných stavbách (kategória 1 DNS), pôjde aj o zabezpečenie užívania schopnosti všetkých technologických vybavení pozemnej stavby. Verejný obstarávateľ bude pri komunikácii v celom procese obstarávania, t. j. pred aj po zaradení do DNS a pred aj po lehote na predkladanie ponúk viažucej sa ku konkrétnej zákazke, postupovať v zmysle § 20 ZVO prostredníctvom komunikačného rozhrania systému JOSEPHINE. Ďalšie informácie o predmete DNS a ostatné podmienky a požiadavky sú uvedené v súťažných podkladoch k zriadeniu DNS a v ich prílohách, dostupné na: https://josephine.proebiz.com/sk/tender/42533/summary

title: FA910126RB011 FARM III RFP
description: This is an RFP for the Arnold Engineering Development Complex (AEDC) FARM III contract. This requirement is being solicited as full and open competition, utilizing Highest Technically Rated Offeror (HTRO) method for evaluation. The FARM III effort is a competitive, multiple-award, Indefinite-Delivery Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract. The scope of these projects includes design-build, construction, and two-phase design-build projects for mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, data, and control systems, and utilities. These projects will support plant and infrastructure sustainment, restoration, and modernization for military ground testing facilities at AEDC and its Geographically Separated Units (GSUs) as detailed in the Statement of Work. The ultimate goal is to support the critical research, development, test, and evaluation mission at AEDC. Please note the following key dates and deadlines: a. Post-Solicitation Conference: A virtual conference will be held on 8 May 2026. Each offeror that is interested in participating as a prime contractor on the FARM III IDIQ will be allotted a 30-minute one-on-one conference with the FARM III source selection team. To sign up to participate in this conference, please respond to the Points of Contact (POCs) listed in paragraph 8 no later than 2:00 PM Central Daylight Time (CDT) on 4 May 2026. Provide a list of attendees and email addresses that will participate in the conference for your company and any questions that you would like to be discussed. b. RFP Questions and Comments Due Date: All questions and comments regarding this RFP are due no later than 2:00 PM CDT on 13 May 2026. Please use the provided FARM III RFP Atch B Questions Template for your submissions and submit it to the Contract Specialist and the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO) at the email addresses provided in paragraph 8. The Government will consider all timely submitted comments and questions for possible incorporation. c. Proposal Due Date: Proposals and all attachments should be submitted in the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) no later than 11:00 AM CDT on 26 May 2026.

description: Die IKK classic gibt hiermit bekannt, dass sie mit allen interessierten und geeigneten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen im Zeitraum vom 01.11.2025 bis zum 31.10.2027 zu verschiedenen Wirkstoffen und Wirkstoffkombinationen nicht-exklusive Rabattvereinbarungen nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zu gleichen, nicht verhandelbaren Bedingungen abschließen wird. Frühester Vertragsbeginn ist der 01.11.2025, sofern der unterschriebene Vertrag und alle nötigen Nachweise, Eigenerklärungen und Unterlagen bis zum 05.10.2025 bei der IKK classic eingehen. Danach gilt: Bei Eingang der Unterlagen bis zum 05. eines jeweiligen Monats im möglichen Beitrittszeitraum wird der jeweils 01. des Folgemonats Vertragsbeginn. Bei Eingang der Unterlagen nach dem 05. eines jeweiligen Monats im möglichen Beitrittszeitraum wird der jeweils 01. des übernächsten Folgemonats Vertragsbeginn. Ein Beitritt zur Vereinbarung ist im angegebenen Zeitraum jederzeit möglich, spätestens jedoch bis zum 05.09.2027. Weitere Angaben siehe Pkt. VI.3).

Sustainability and energy enhancement measures are included. Supporting facilities including site development with demolition, utilizes and connections, steam for clothes pressing room, storm drainage, paving, parking, walkways, lighting, information systems, landscaping, and signage. description: SUBJECT: � Robins Agile Practices for Infrastructure Development (RAPID) Umbrella Program Notice (10 U.S.C. � 2808a Other Transaction Authority) 1. BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT (BLUF) The Department of the Air Force, specifically the 78th Civil Engineer Group (78 CEG) at Robins Air Force Base (AFB), Georgia, is publishing this Umbrella Program Notice to announce the establishment of the Robins Agile Practices for Infrastructure Development (RAPID) acquisition framework. Operating under the innovative statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. � 2808a, RAPID seeks to completely modernize base infrastructure and execute facility repair and construction projects using flexible, commercial-style Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs). Traditional Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) rules do not apply, enabling the Air Force to engage directly with local, regional, and national commercial builders who have limited or no prior federal contracting experience. 2. PROGRAM STRUCTURE & TIMELINE Rather than a single, one-off project solicitation, this Notice establishes the RAPID Umbrella Program, which will remain active for one (1) full year from the date of this posting. During this 12-month period, the Government will periodically publish project-specific solicitations, referred to as Areas of Interest (AOIs), directly under this umbrella. Each independent AOI will outline: The specific facility construction, repair, or modernization project requirements. The exact response date, time, and instructions for submitting Solution Briefs. The collaborative delivery model designated for that project, such as Progressive Design-Build (PDB) utilizing open-book Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) pricing, or Build-Only (BO) commercial delivery. Program ParameterDetailsStatutory Authority10 U.S.C. � 2808a (Standalone Facility Construction or Repair Authority)Umbrella Active Period12 Months (Continuous Open Notice)Execution VehicleProject-Specific Areas of Interest (AOIs) & Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs)Key FlexibilitiesNo FAR boilerplate clauses, standard commercial accounting (No CAS), negotiable termsFollow-on AuthorityEligible for non-competitive, sole-source follow-on production construction under � 2808a(c) 3. ELIGIBILITY & PARTICIPATION The RAPID framework actively seeks to lower barriers to entry. Unlike prototype OTAs, 10 U.S.C. � 2808a carries no statutory Nontraditional Defense Contractor (NDC) prerequisites and zero cost-share mandates. Commercial general contractors, specialty trades, design-build firms, and joint ventures are all fully eligible and strongly encouraged to monitor this notice and participate. 4. ACTION REQUIRED FOR INTERESTED VENDORS Interested commercial builders and designers should take the following immediate steps to prepare for upcoming RAPID projects: Monitor This Posting: Bookmark this SAM.gov notice. All project-specific AOIs will be posted as amendments or linked notices here. Register on SAM.gov: Ensure your company has an active, completely free registration and Unique Entity ID (UEI) on SAM.gov. Form Teaming Alliances: Begin networking with regional design firms, general contractors, and trade subcontractors to build integrated design-build consortia capable of executing rapid, commercial-style projects.
